a. (-वी f.) [इक्षु-अण्] Made of, or produced from, sugarcane, sugary. 
-वम् 
__1 Sugar. 
__2 A kind of spirituous liquor.

a. [इक्षु-ठञ्] 
__1 Suitable for sugar-cane. 
__2 Bearing sugar-cane. 
-कः A carrier of sugar-cane.
a. [इक्षुभार-ठञ्] Carrying a load of sugar-canes.

a. [इक्ष्वाकु-अण्] Belonging to Ikṣvāku. 
-कः, -कुः 
__1 A descendant of Ikṣvāku; सत्यमैक्ष्वाकः खल्वसि [[

.]] 
__2 The country ruled by the Aikṣvākus.
